optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Conversational AI Engineer, Support Chat Assistant
professionalSummary: Experienced in training, evaluating, and releasing intent classification and answer retrieval models for a SaaS support chat assistant. Developed an offline evaluation harness and authored model cards and release notes. Demonstrated coordination with platform teams and documentation of model limitations.
experienceHighlights: Trained and evaluated intent and answer models using annotated corpora and replay sets; built and maintained an offline evaluation harness scoring intent accuracy, retrieval recall, and regression detection; prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team; authored model cards and release notes detailing training data cuts, replay-set results, and known failure modes.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Evaluation harness report for the last three release candidates (sandbox experiment identifiers); model card for the intent classifier.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with training, evaluating, and documenting intent and answer models, as well as coordinating release candidates with the platform team. They do not confirm live deployment, monitoring of deflection/handoff rates, or on-call incident handling.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has partial evidence for several requirements but lacks confirmation of live deployment and incident handling.

role.roleTitle: Conversational AI Engineer, Support Chat Assistant

evidence.text: Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which held the release pipeline, the live dashboards and the on-call rota; my involvement ended at the release review, and I did not have access to the live conversation data.
evidence.notes: Shows release preparation but no live deployment evidence.

evidence.text: candidate said he had 'shipped the intent models that run the assistant' and that 'my models handle about a million conversations a month'; asked about incidents, he described a replay-set regression found before a release and said the platform team 'carried the pager'.
evidence.notes: Suggests live deployment but not confirmed.

missingEvidence: Confirmation of live deployment and monitoring of deflection/handoff rates.
Evidence of handling model incidents on-call, such as regressions or mis-routing spikes.

evidence.text: Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which held the release pipeline, the live dashboards and the on-call rota; my involvement ended at the release review, and I did not have access to the live conversation data.
evidence.notes: Directly shows coordination with platform team.

evidence.text: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.
Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.
Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate has trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant.
supportedClaims.witness: Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate built an offline evaluation harness that scores models before release.
supportedClaims.witness: Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team.
supportedClaims.witness: Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which held the release pipeline, the live dashboards and the on-call rota; my involvement ended at the release review, and I did not have access to the live conversation data.

supportedClaims.claim: Candidate authored model cards and release notes detailing training data cuts, replay-set results, and known failure modes.
supportedClaims.witness: Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate has released intent and answer models into the live assistant and monitors deflection and hand-off rates on live traffic.
unsupportedClaims.reason: No evidence of live deployment or monitoring.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide logs, dashboards, or statements confirming live deployment and monitoring of deflection/handoff rates.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate handles model incidents such as post-release regressions or mis-routing spikes through the assistant's on-call rota.
unsupportedClaims.reason: No evidence of incident handling or on-call participation.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Provide incident reports, pager logs, or testimony confirming on-call incident resolution.
